interpretation: "Domestic league" was taken to mean any top-division national club football league in any country (e.g., La Liga, Premier League, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Campeonato Brasileiro Série A, etc.), and each player's full professional career across all clubs and countries was considered to identify every such league he participated in and whether he won that league's season-long best player award (as voted by players' unions, the football writers' association, the league body, or equivalent press bodies), expressly excluding monthly/weekly awards, top-scorer trophies, young-player awards, goalkeeper awards, and continental/international honours.
